name: Trips - Right - 18 Sweep

QB.rule: Take the snap and sweep right, flat and fast, behind the trips. Turn up outside the fullback.

TB.rule: Run hard to the left like you have the ball. Sell it all the way.

coaching_points: The quarterback keeps it every time — tell him before the snap, there is no read.
He stays behind the trips until the fullback's block is made, then turns it up.
